sentences.en: Mennad spent his entire junior year in a psychiatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 梅纳德整个大二学年都在精神病医院度过。

sentences.en: Most psychiatric wards are still very abusive and traumatizing places.
sentences.zh: 大多数的精神病病房仍然是非常虐待性和创伤性的地方。

sentences.en: Yanni is going to be moved into a psychiatric ward.
sentences.zh: 扬尼将会被转移到精神科病房。

senses.zh: 精神病学的；精神病治疗的
